name: Omnia Holdings Limited
summary: Omnia Holdings Limited, together with its subsidiaries, research, develops, manufactures, and supplies chemicals, specialised services, and solutions for the agriculture, mining, and chemicals application industries in South Africa, rest of Africa, and internationally. It operates through Agriculture RSA, Agriculture Rest of Africa, Agriculture International, Mining RSA, Mining International, and Chemicals segments. The company manufactures and trades in granular, liquid, and specialty fertilizers; humates and other biostimulants; and fulvates, kelp, microbial products.
